title: Home infra (full stack)
summary: Own the complete GotchiBot home stack: Docker watched set, Cloudflare tunnel/public subgraph, Hub/OpenClaw, Tailscale path, agent mesh/remote, and Desk→Hub Claude bridge. Watch, probe, recover paper-only. Public operators who run a subset install the piece packs: infra-docker, infra-tunnel, infra-hub, infra-tailscale, infra-mesh, infra-bridge.
autonomy: Home full-stack desk (Julius YFI). Composes six marketplace modules: infra-docker, infra-tunnel, infra-hub, infra-tailscale, infra-mesh, infra-bridge — public installs can take any subset; this hero owns all of them. Resident watcher in tmux gotchibot:infrawatch ticks every 60s and reports transitions, not steady state. Every 30 ticks and on every transition it asks a persistent interactive Claude CLI session, in tmux window gotchibot:claude-verify, for an independent verdict; because that session keeps context it can say what changed since the last check. A disagreement between Claude and the probes is treated as an incident. The 15-minute wake is the launchd job com.gotchibot.infra-watch installed on the iMac by `./scripts/gotchibot infra schedule install`, which restarts the watcher window if it died; `./scripts/gotchibot infra schedule status` is the only source of truth for whether that job is loaded and the watcher heartbeat is fresh. The verify session runs in ~/Dev/gotchibot-infra-verify, outside the GotchiBot repo, so it does not inherit the repo CLAUDE.md hub-proxy role. Only the watched aarcade/envio containers gate the docker check. On degrade follow infra-recover (paper-only).

selfServe: Docker autostart: ~/Library/Group Containers/group.com.docker/settings-store.json -> "AutoStart": true (a file, not a GUI-only checkbox)
Container never returns after a reboot: docker update --restart unless-stopped <container>
docker restart succeeds but StartedAt does not move: docker kill then docker start; the cure is recreating with --init

abra dies with Cannot find package ...abracadabra/dist/index.js: cd ~/Dev/abracadabra && npm ci (lockfile restore, allowed). Usually a disk-space cleanup that deleted node_modules across all of ~/Dev (42 of 45 projects on 2026-09-06) — check ls ~/Dev/<project>/node_modules before blaming the host or tunnel
needsUser: sudo shutdown -r now — no NOPASSWD rule on the iMac, so no agent can reboot the host; reassigning to another hero hits the same wall
anything needing the login keychain non-interactively (docker credential helper, abra on the iMac over SSH)
